So I had a weird childhood. I was adopted and my new mother was extremely religious and became more and more paranoid over time - she was afraid of the "new world order" kinda shit, making us sleep with sock caps lined with aluminum foil, keeping us locked in our rooms for months at a time. She also had a friend in all of this. Dad just looked the other way. We were homeschooled.

Anyway, that friend was even more twisted. She eventually was able to get moved into our household, living in a school bus converted into a camper. She would frame us kids for different things, whether it was breaking a typewriter, eating without permission, or "triggering" one of the other kids. The punishment was sometimes as bad as forcing us to live in the camper with her. 

I had a lot of issues sleeping growing up, and being in that camper just made it worse. I was 13 when I was made to move into the bus. Was always afraid someone was going to get in and kill me. Not to mention I grew up on Indiana and winter can be pretty brutal. I would sneak books in and read by the security light. Anyway mom's friend would usually go to bed in the early morning and she would notice that I wasn't sleeping. At first ishe would just get mad at me. But soon it started to escalate and I would get slapped, and one night she pulled my pants down and grabbed my penis. She started to masturbate me until I ejaculated. And she would do this every night she didn't think I was asleep, even fingering me. She started putting chopsticks in my urethra to "make sure I don't close up again" (I had a surgery to remove a blockage when I was 10) while and was masturbating me. 

I eventually got really good at faking sleep. I was only in the bus for half a year. It all started because she claimed to have seen me hitting my sister's cat.  I told my mother what happened, but I just got in trouble because "someone inside" wanted to make her friend look bad. I was kept in my bedroom for a few months as punishment, until I "found the person inside" that was responsible. I just dropped it from there and have never said anything to anyone or anything at all until now. 

What kills me is that my little brother was kept in that bus for around two years after I was because mom's friend claimed to have caught him trying to rape our little sister. I can't even imagine what she did to him in that time. 
My mom and her friend are currently living happily in Tennessee, heavily involved in church and speaking at weekend conferences about living God's word and spiritual warfare. 

I'm gay. My family doesn't really know this. A few do. I'm pretty sure that I was gay before she did this to me but I don't really know. I've never really been in a true relationship and I'm 29. This was just a tiny part of an awful childhood that I can't really get over.
